chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel; who they are.
chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly a systematic, intra-cosmic taxonomy of three name-categories (“god / rich one / angel”) across successive emanational levels. Later material is mainly the dialogue/frame attributions (“enlightener…”, “apostle…”, disciples’ request). The final triad using “household of …” retains cosmic referents and reads as part of the same classificatory scheme, despite a slight rise in application-style connectives.

paragraphs.core_text: This one, a name is given to him in the world. For people pronounce it with their mouths: 'god', 'rich one', and 'angel'. Who are they? Who are the gods? Or who are the rich ones? Or who are the angels? Who are these [three] archetypes?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: “Once again the enlightener speaks:” (later editorial presentation of the teaching).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Frame attribution introduces an otherwise impersonal definitional problem (names as categories). The content itself sets up a threefold cosmological classification and does not yet point to institutions.
Pure Q&A frame: disciples addressing “our master” and requesting instruction; no cosmological explication.

paragraphs.core_text: There are these three archetypes [in the land of light, and there is no measure to] them!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution: “The apostle speaks to them:” (Layer-2/dialogue frame marker).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core teaching voice is brief and ontological (“in the land of light… no measure”), but introduced by a later dialogue label using “apostle.”

paragraphs.core_text: So, the ones who are called 'god', are the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself. He has established them after the likeness of his greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic intra-cosmic definition: name-category (“god”) is mapped to emanational origin (summoned from the Father) and likeness; impersonal expository voice.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, these who are named 'rich [ ... ]', are the evocations of the first rich gods of the Father; because, when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations. They called them 'rich'.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second tier of a threefold emanational cascade (Father → first gods → their evocations). The mapping remains entirely within the cosmological system; lacuna preserved.

paragraphs.core_text: They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them 'angel'. These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light. There is no measure to apply to them!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the three-step structure (god → rich one → angel) with reiterated “no measure” formula typical of timeless Light-world exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: Once again, listen! Other persons who are named 'god' are the emanations who have come from the Father; the evocations of the Father whom he summoned forth. They came out to the contest and humiliated the enmity.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Shifts from archetypes-in-Light to the same categories manifested in cosmic history (“contest… enmity”), still describing what the beings do within the mythic mechanism, not addressing church life.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the 'rich ones' are the evocations of these first living words. They too, the rich ones, have come and performed and fulfilled the pleasure of the greatness, in the worlds that are above and below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the second-level application of the triad into the created/mixed cosmos (“worlds… above and below”), maintaining the internal emanational logic.

paragraphs.core_text: On the other hand, the ones who are named the 'angels' are the evocations of the rich ones, who had come from the three living words. They have been sent in an embassy and an apostolate to this building. They have come to the entire divinity, which is established in silence and in hiddenness. And, also, they have come to all the souls who have been entangled in the enemy. They have brought them hope and confidence.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Still a third-tier definition (angels as evocations) with mission described inside the cosmic drama (souls entangled in the enemy). The term “apostolate” is a later/Christianizing lexical tint, but there is no NT citation or external institutional identification; the paragraph functions as cosmological role-description.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, they are called 'god', all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue/frame attribution: “Once again the enlightener speaks:” (editorial voice marker).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Returns to a list-like, classificatory scheme (“they are called…”) but prefaced by a compilation frame formula.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, the ones who are called 'angel', are all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Triadic, parallel taxonomy continues; “household of …” names a cosmic administration rather than a contemporary institution.

paragraphs.core_text: The ones who are called 'rich', are all the rich ones who belong to the household of the glorious Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the final triad with a named cosmic figure (the Ambassador) in the same systematic register; no frame/citation markers.
